description: Headline numbers copied from docs/calibration/calibration_results.json and docs/validation/validation_results.csv (regenerate after recalibration).

score_validation.label: distress proxy: next-year net loss or negative operating cash flow (a proxy, not observed bankruptcy or default)
score_validation.method: standardised logistic regression on the five category scores; 5-fold GroupKFold by company (no company in both train and test); out-of-fold ROC AUC with company-level bootstrap 95% CI

definitions.persistence: this year's status (net loss or negative operating cash flow) used as the prediction
definitions.two_ratio: min(net margin, operating cash flow margin) this year, lower = riskier

data_validation.scope_note: US companies only; Indian companies have not yet been checked against their annual reports
